# Amelia Airhoof

Amelia Airhoof is the pale blue-gray Pegasus flight-school instructor seen in Rainbow Dash’s childhood flashback in *Newbie Dash* (S6E7, May 7, 2016). She is memorable for laughing along when her pupil is humiliated, rather than intervening.

- **Appearance:** Pale cyan-gray coat, nearly white mane and tail, light cyan eyes. The [Pegasus character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) traces her design to an early unused Surprise design for the series premiere; that does not establish that she is Surprise herself.
- **Name:** A fandom name, apparently a pun on aviator Amelia Earhart. No official naming source or original naming poll was verified.
- **Speaking status:** No individually attributed dialogue or voice actor was found in the [episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=64760). Group laughter is not a confirmed individual voice credit.
- **Appearances:** Her flashback is the only verified appearance in the G4 television continuity. No film or comic appearance was verified.
- **Images:** The [episode stills gallery](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Newbie_Dash/Gallery) documents the teacher’s reaction. A direct image and its individual file page could not both be verified, so no image is embedded.

## Important moments

- **The teacher laughs at Rainbow Crash — Newbie Dash (S6E7).** After young Rainbow Dash crashes into a trash can, her classmates mock her and the instructor laughs along, underscoring why the nickname hurts Rainbow years later. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nwVhhmZxY80) — exact video timestamp unavailable; the character catalog places her appearance around 6:17.

Only one character-defining scene was substantiated. The wiki pages were available in search indexes but blocked direct retrieval.
